fixes.title: Add Product and Offer data to the product page
fixes.why: Shopping agents look for Product structured data to read the name, price and stock. The product page has none an agent can use, because its only JSON-LD block is broken.
fixes.how: Replace the broken block on the product page with a valid Product JSON-LD block containing name and an Offer with price, priceCurrency and availability.

fixes.title: Fix the JSON-LD syntax error
fixes.why: One of the two JSON-LD blocks does not parse (a property name is not double-quoted), so agents discard it entirely.
fixes.how: Correct the JSON syntax in the script tag on {{origin}}/products/morning-blend and validate the output after each template change.

fixes.title: Label the phone field in the cart
fixes.why: Two of three cart fields are labelled; the phone field is not, so an agent has to guess what goes there.
fixes.how: Add a <label for> element (or aria-label) to the phone input on the cart page.

fixes.title: Add og:image and og:url to the home page
fixes.why: The home page has some OpenGraph tags but lacks og:image and og:url, so previews and agents miss the canonical URL and image.
fixes.how: Add og:image and og:url meta tags to the home page head.

fixes.title: Add lastmod dates to the sitemap
fixes.why: The sitemap lists 3 URLs but none has a lastmod date, so agents cannot tell what changed.
fixes.how: Generate <lastmod> for each URL in the sitemap from the page's last update time.

fixes.title: Reformat llms.txt (proposed convention)
fixes.why: llms.txt is a proposed convention with low weight. Yours exists but does not start with a '# Title' heading and has no Markdown links.
fixes.how: Start the file with '# ' and the site name, then list key pages as Markdown links.
